verdicts.reason: Both use the same 5-line headline. It runs almost to the side edges, wraps with 'little' alone on its own line, and the subtitle sits jammed right under 'sunshine.'. A anchors the CTA near the bottom edge, so the canvas fills evenly, but there is a loose ~100px gap that detaches the button from its copy and only a thin bottom margin. B keeps the CTA grouped with the copy, but the whole block is pushed up with about 45px at the top and about 110px of dead orange at the bottom, so it looks top-heavy rather than centred like the original.
